rationale: firebase-tools carries no advisory of its own. It is a devDependency used only to run local emulators and to deploy from a developer or release machine; it never ships in a deployed artifact. It is held at ~15.22.4, which brings tar 7.5.22 and clears every tar advisory. 15.34.0 also drops proxy-agent (and with it basic-ftp, get-uri, and pac-proxy-agent) and moves to csv-parse 7, but since 15.23.0 the CLI sends every request, emulator calls to 127.0.0.1 included, through HTTPS_PROXY and ignores NO_PROXY. On a machine with a proxy set, the Storage emulator then cannot read Firestore, and the storage rules that call firestore.exists() deny the owner. The chokidar ^3 (braces 3.0.3, no patched release), @google-cloud/pubsub ^5 (@opentelemetry/core 1.x), and gaxios ^6 (uuid 9.x) findings remain in every 15.x release, 15.34.0 included. npm's proposed fix is firebase-tools@13.13.3, a downgrade. Move to the newest 15.x once a release honours NO_PROXY for emulator traffic.
